cues.text: This is a shot-by-shot recreation of two Watch Dogs trailers, rendered entirely in code. The side-by-side comparison starts at 59 seconds, so feel free to skip ahead.
I studied the trailers frame by frame, wrote a shot list, and rebuilt every shot in code, checking each one against the source until it lined up.
Every frame is a pure function of time: the same timestamp always renders the same image, so the film can be scrubbed, exported, and measured.
First I built a small toolkit: typed highlights, glitch slicing, dot-matrix type, network graphs, pixelation, and procedural 3D cities.
Then six AI agents rebuilt the trailers in parallel, one time range each, while I built the engine and stitched the seams.
Version two adds real OpenStreetMap buildings, NASA imagery, 3D post-processing, and camera moves solved in Blender.
Here's the comparison: my recreation on the left, the original on the right.
